title: Daanton Ki Safai (Brushing)

good.title: Subah-Shaam Brush Karna
good.desc: Daant motiyon jaise chamakte hain aur germs door bhagte hain.

bad.title: Bina Brush Kiye Sona
bad.desc: Daanton me keede lag jate hain aur dard hota hai.

marquee_text: ⭐ Subah uth kar aur raat ko sone se pehle 2 minute brush karein ⭐ Daant rahenge swasth aur chamkile ⭐
rhyme: Brush brush brush your teeth, keep them clean and bright! Subah bhi karo, shaam bhi karo, day and night!

title: Haath Dhona (Hand Washing)

good.title: Sabun Se Haath Dhona
good.desc: Bimariyan aur kitanu pet me nahi jaate.

bad.title: Gande Haathon Se Khana
bad.desc: Pet me dard aur infection ho sakta hai.

marquee_text: ⭐ Khane se pehle aur toilet ke baad 20 second tak sabun se haath dhoyen ⭐
rhyme: Wash wash wash your hands, soap and water play! Saaf haath se khana khao, beemari bhagaye!

title: Subah Jaldi Uthna (Early Rising)

good.title: Early To Rise
good.desc: Sharir me taazgi aati hai aur dimaag khush rehta hai.

bad.title: Der Tak Sote Rehna
bad.desc: Alas rehta hai aur school ke liye late ho jate hain.

marquee_text: ⭐ Early to bed and early to rise, makes a child healthy, wealthy and wise ⭐
rhyme: Suraj nikla mita andhera, dekho bacho hua savera! Jaldi uthkar karo pranam, banenge sare bigde kaam!

title: Paushtik Aahar (Healthy Eating)

good.title: Hari Sabziyan Aur Phal Khana
good.desc: Taqat milti hai aur shareer superhero jaisa banta hai.

bad.title: Sirf Junk Food Aur Chips Khana
bad.desc: Pet kharab hota hai aur shareer kamzor ho jata hai.

marquee_text: ⭐ Roti, daal, hari sabzi aur doodh roz lein ⭐ Junk food kabhi-kabhi hi khayein ⭐
rhyme: Green vegetables taaza phal, dete humko taqat kal! Junk food ko kaho bye-bye, sehat se dosti banaye!

title: Paani Peena (Hydration)

good.title: Din Bhar Khoob Paani Peena
good.desc: Shareer active rehta hai aur digestion behtar hota hai.

bad.title: Paani Ki Jagah Soda Peena
bad.desc: Dehydration aur daanto me cavity hoti hai.

marquee_text: ⭐ Roz 6 se 8 glass saaf paani peena swasthya ke liye amrit hai ⭐
rhyme: Pani pani pyara paani, jeevan ki ye meethi nani! Khoob piyo thanda jal, active rahoge har pal!

title: Screen Time Control

good.title: Bahar Park Me Khelna
good.desc: Aankhein swasth rehti hain aur dosto ke sath masti hoti hai.

bad.title: Ghanton Mobile/TV Dekhna
bad.desc: Aankhein thak jati hain aur sar me dard hota hai.

marquee_text: ⭐ Din me sirf 30-40 minute screen time! Sham ko doston ke sath ground me khelein ⭐
rhyme: Chhodo mobile aao maidan, dhoop hawa me hai vardaan! Daud lagao ball chalao, tandurust body banao!

title: Bado Ka Aadar (Respect Elders)

good.title: Namaste Aur Dhanyawaad Bolna
good.desc: Sabhi ka aashirwaad aur pyar milta hai.

bad.title: Chilakar Ya Gusse Me Bolna
bad.desc: Bado ka dil dukhta hai aur sab udaas hote hain.

marquee_text: ⭐ Hamesha 'Please', 'Thank You' aur 'Sorry' ka pyara prayog karein ⭐
rhyme: Mummy papa ko pranam, guru janon ka lo naam! Meethi vani sabko bhaye, sabka dulara bacha kehlaye!

title: Kachra Dustbin Me (Cleanliness)

good.title: Kachra Dustbin Me Daalna
good.desc: Ghar aur sadak saaf-suthri aur sundar rehti hai.

bad.title: Idhar-Udhar Wrappers Phekna
bad.desc: Gandagi phailti hai aur makkhiyan aati hain.

marquee_text: ⭐ Mera Bharat Swachh Bharat! Wrappers hamesha dustbin me hi daalein ⭐
rhyme: Saaf safai apnao, gandagi door bhagao! Chhilka dabba dalo bin me, khushiyan aayengi aagan me!

title: Mil Baant Kar Khana (Sharing)

good.title: Dosto Ke Sath Share Karna
good.desc: Dosti mazboot hoti hai aur khushi dugni ho jati hai.

bad.title: Akele Sab Khana Ya Chheen-na
bad.desc: Dost naraz hote hain aur akelepan lagta hai.

marquee_text: ⭐ Sharing is Caring! Apne khilone aur snacks doston ke sath baatein ⭐
rhyme: Sharing brings a happy smile, dosti chalti meelon mile! Jo baate apna aahar, uspar barse sabka pyar!

title: Samay Par Padhai (Study Time)

good.title: Roz Time Par Homework Karna
good.desc: Class me first aate hain aur exam ka dar nahi rehta.

bad.title: Padhai Kal Par Taalna
bad.desc: Bohot sara kaam jama ho jata hai aur tension hoti hai.

marquee_text: ⭐ Roz thoda samay padhai ko dein, revision hamesha aage rakhta hai ⭐
rhyme: Padhoge likhoge banoge nawaab, khele koodoge banoge kharab! Samay par karo apna kaam, chamkega tabhi tumhara naam!

title: Sach Bolna (Honesty)

good.title: Hamesha Sach Bolna
good.desc: Man bilkul shant aur nidar rehta hai.

bad.title: Galti Chhupane Ke Liye Jhooth Bolna
bad.desc: Ek jhooth ke liye 100 jhooth bolne padte hain aur vishwas toot-ta hai.

marquee_text: ⭐ Sach bolne wale hamesha sachhe veer hote hain ⭐
rhyme: Sach ki raah par chalna seekho, jhooth se hamesha bachna seekho! Sachha bacha fearless rehta, sabka aadar samman paata!

title: Raat Ko Samay Par Sona (Sleeping Early)

good.title: 9 Baje Sona
good.desc: Subah bina roye chehre par muskan ke sath aankh khulti hai.

bad.title: Raat 12 Baje Tak Jagna
bad.desc: Subah thakan rehti hai aur school me neend aati hai.

marquee_text: ⭐ Bacha agar 8-9 ghante soye to dimag tez aur body tall banti hai ⭐
rhyme: Chanda mama so gaye, taare bhi chup ho gaye! Tum bhi so jao pyare bachhe, aayenge sapne sachhe-sachhe!
